==Welcome!==
Hello, and [[Wikipedia:Welcome, newcomers|welcome]] to '''A Wheel of Time Wiki'''!. Thanks for your edit to the File:Spiderweb-icon.png page. I hope you like the place and decide to stay. Here are a few good links for newcomers:
* '''Local:'''

**[[project:Be bold|Be bold! We need your help!]]
**[[Help:Edit_summary|Leave an edit summary when you make changes]]

*'''Wikipedia:'''
**[[m:Help:Editing|How to edit a page]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Tutorial|Tutorial]]
**[[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Five pillars|The five pillars of Wikipedia]]

I hope you enjoy editing here and helping us get this project started. By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin 2000]] ([[User_talk:Moridin 2000|Talk]]) 20:39, November 11, 2009

:Yes, I'm the one that made [[:File:Telaran-icon.svg]]. Thanks for your praise! And I do plan on making .svg files for some of the other chapter art icons. I'd like to say I'll do them all, but that may be too ambitious since I'll just be doing them when I have a bit of spare time here and there. I make them/edit them using [http://www.inkscape.org/ Inkscape], which is open source and free to download.
